name: ICO Group Limited
summary: ICO Group Limited, established in 1992 and headquartered in Kowloon, Hong Kong, is an investment holding firm providing IT application services to institutional and corporate clients in Hong Kong and abroad. Its segments cover application development, IT infrastructure, staff secondment, maintenance and support, and property leasing with e-commerce. Clients come from banking, finance, insurance, government, telecommunications, retail, logistics and education.
